resources.string: Convert period totals for display only. Original amounts and period currencies stay unchanged. Use currency codes such as USD, BRL or EUR. IRT means traditional toman, 10 IRR per IRT; set its rate manually.
Units of the target currency per 1 source unit. Use a decimal point. Manual rates override reference rates in both directions.

Frankfurter reference rates. Not live trading or street-market rates. Only currency codes are sent, never amounts. Fetch when needed; saved rates work offline.
